- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.12.0+dev-412-g4160bd6ef

## Description

It would be cool if you can configure which languages to hide in the language stats panel.  
If this is to much work, we could consider hiding svg by default, because that are mainly assets.

## Screenshots

![Screenshot_20200302_113201](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11004008/75668562-c8ed1400-5c79-11ea-8012-0ae5c26b7a3c.png)
comments:
Agree on having an option, but nothing should be hidden by default so we stay neutral.

This issue has been automatically closed because of inactivity. You can re-open it if needed.

review_comments: There is no reason to range every language in `stat`, you can just range every language in `specialLanguages` and perform `delete` (which is no-op if doesn't exist) on `stats` with that key.
That also means you'll be able to move `specialLanguages` from map to slice.
I still need to loop to calculate total size & percentages in second loop
